same_far_rule: Ascending negative event-min scores, only attainable grouped thresholds; earliest threshold on a zero-slope FAR plateau, including origin no-alarm; linear interpolation between adjacent distinct FARs; no extrapolation
positive_score: Minimum prediction strictly before first crossing; absent scores are +Inf
bootstrap: 4000 paired physical-event draws, all noise conditions travel together; recompute the full bracket on each resample
clean_threshold_decomposition: Complete 2x2 score/threshold swap at original pooled 10%; symmetric average contribution, descriptive, no causal attribution
